title: Rebuild Index for This Project
summary: Walks a project's .dproj compile closure and (re)builds its index
intro: Read this after adding or moving units, or when hover, Find Usages or lint results feel stale. It walks the project .dproj compile closure and rebuilds the index for that project.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Index & Maintenance > Rebuild Index for This Project
steps: Open the project in RAD Studio
Choose drag-lint > Index & Maintenance > Rebuild Index for This Project
Wait for the indexing run to finish; progress shows in the IDE

questions.ask: How do I rebuild the index for the project I have open?
How do I refresh the index after edits without a full rebuild?
